newsitem.title: USA: CBOE glad to get go-ahead on NYSE options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE glad to get go-ahead on NYSE options.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange said Thursday it was glad to get the go-ahead to negotiate the purchase of the New York Stock Exchange's options business.

"The Chicago Board Options Exchange is very pleased to have been selected by the New York Stock Exchange to negotiate the transfer of their options business to Chicago," CBOE president and chief operating officer Charles Henry said in a statement.
"We will now begin working on a mutually acceptable agreement," he said.
The NYSE said earlier its board had recommended that the exchange negotiate the sale of its options business with the CBOE. The options unit had been for sale since earlier this year.
The CBOE did not provide details on its proposal for the unit or say when the negotiations would begin.
The CBOE beat out competing bids from the American Stock Exchange, Philadelphia Stock Exchange, Pacific Stock Exchange and New York Cotton Exchange.
